academicJudgment.claimTested: A complete bachelor response, a qualified90-EC academic-year core comparison, and a still narrower current first-year-only claim were each challenged; no numerical EC cutoff was applied.
academicJudgment.strongestPositiveArgument: The documented study is substantive: social/cultural sustainability, regional histories and power, environmental art/history, empirical cultural research, material culture, conversation analysis, climate interaction and a10EC societal project. Current UCR supplies actual stylistic, visual/material, qualitative, civil-society, climate-communication and governance inquiry. Two coherent full180EC trials make qualification plausible and defeat an automatic negative conclusion.
academicJudgment.decision: Remain external-programme-unresolved. The missing selected regional-language formation and settled advanced/capstone integration are defining parts of this particular society-language-culture degree, not an isolated administrative defect. The90EC current-year snapshot crosses cohorts and does not establish the applicable later academic core for a new entrant. A first-year-only boundary would preserve real foundational relationships but omit the sustained regional/empirical/applied formation that gives those broad themes their bachelor-level meaning. The current evidence does not settle a sufficiently stable substantial core for the proposed whole UCR response.

adverseResolutions.resolution: The selected minor and advanced curriculum emphasize sustained French linguistic/regional-cultural inquiry, empirical interaction and partner-based applied research.
adverseResolutions.effect: The closest UCR cultural/media/governance trial has genuine strengths but lacks that organizing regional formation and dedicated conversation-analysis sequence. The proposed limited bachelor claim would require substantive reconsideration.

academicJudgment.negativeProof: A robust no-match fails: UCR offers strong directly relevant cultural, communication and environmental-humanities work. Missing proficiency alone is not proof. A credible favorable advanced allocation could support comparison.
academicJudgment.indispensableEvidence: Applicable settled STC later-year/cohort allocation, selected regional-language package content and conditions, final-work/whitepaper outcomes and progression. Separately authorized reconsideration should reassess only affected concepts, sequencing, alignments and scope.

courseReview.finding: Read real current content for every selected lead course. Style & Meaning is linguistic stylistics rather than proficiency. Archaeology/heritage and art/museums supply material/visual/history inquiry; Qualitative Research supplies actual interviews/coding/visual methods. Climate media/rhetoric, environmental justice and civil-society work directly sustain broad inquiry. Environmental science, water and renewable design are specific complements, not automatically environmental humanities. Ethics is general moral theory; no specialist environmental-ethics equivalence.
courseReview.limitations: No sustained French/German/Spanish language or regional-studies sequence, guaranteed STC-specific capstone, or unverified dedicated empirical-conversation curriculum is invented. Current Style & Meaning does contain dialogue/turn-taking and discourse methods; that is a real partial contribution, not the full social-interaction training.
